complete_table_filters.name: canonical full table
complete_table_filters.rule: canonicalize r under all simultaneous relabelings before expensive filters

complete_table_filters.name: congruence rigidity
complete_table_filters.rule: every congruence generated by a nontrivial pair must be universal

complete_table_filters.name: subsolution rigidity
complete_table_filters.rule: reject if any nonempty proper S satisfies U[S,S],V[S,S] subset S

complete_table_filters.name: observer rigidity
complete_table_filters.rule: the graph generated by x~U[x,y] and y~V[x,y] must be connected

complete_table_filters.name: flip-across exclusion
complete_table_filters.rule: reject partitions A sqcup B with crossing-closed blocks and mixed rows equal to flip-across

coordinate_model.balanced_counts: bijectivity forces every symbol to occur exactly d times in U and exactly d times in V
coordinate_model.bijectivity: the d^2 output pairs (U[x,y],V[x,y]) are all distinct
coordinate_model.everywhere_singularity: every U-row y -> U[x,y] is non-bijective and every V-column x -> V[x,y] is non-bijective
coordinate_model.pair_orthogonality: for every u,v, exactly one cell in U^{-1}(u) receives V=v

everywhere_singular_filters.name: minimal-image filter
everywhere_singular_filters.rule: form S_L and S_R from minimal-size generator images; reject if either is nonempty proper crossing-closed

everywhere_singular_filters.bounds: at most d^d transformations: 3125 for d=5 and 46656 for d=6
everywhere_singular_filters.name: semigroup-minimal image filter
everywhere_singular_filters.rule: close the transformation semigroups <L_x> and <R_y>; test unions of minimal semigroup images for proper crossing-closed subsets

everywhere_singular_filters.name: fibre-pair congruence filter
everywhere_singular_filters.rule: kernel pairs of any singular L_x or R_y must generate universal YBE congruences

everywhere_singular_filters.name: kernel-hypergraph connectedness
everywhere_singular_filters.rule: nontrivial fibres of all L_x and R_y form a connected hypergraph; disconnected component partitions seed observer and congruence checks

pipeline: solve V as exact cover with Y2/Y3 propagation
run compressed rack-prefix pressure only on survivors

certificates: proper active-factor certificates into racks or smaller dominated YBE factors
positive_certificate_search.checks: local two-letter equations plus pair-automaton injectivity

rack_prefix_pressure.compression: represent the detector on the disjoint union Omega_{<=k,n}=coprod_R R^n over racks R of size <=k
rack_prefix_pressure.criterion: a braid is trivial on the product rack iff it is trivial on every factor, equivalently on the disjoint-union detector
rack_prefix_pressure.kernel_test: N_{<=k,n}(X) is the X-block projection of the kernel of Gamma_{<=k,n}(X)-><D_i^(n)>
priority: P_{<=4}, n=6,7 only for structural survivors
rack_prefix_pressure.warning: do not build the product rack P_{<=4} as a set

stage_a_u_enumeration.bucket_checkpoint: for every (u,P), store cells C(u,P)={(x,y):L_x(y)=u, L_x L_y=P} and values V(u,P)={v:L_u L_v=P}
stage_a_u_enumeration.canonicalization: U^pi[x,y]=pi(U[pi^{-1}x,pi^{-1}y]); keep the lexicographically minimal word over all d! relabelings
constraints: each symbol occurs exactly d times globally in U
for each cell (x,y), A_xy is nonempty
the multiset-factorization law holds for every output u
U is canonical under simultaneous relabeling
stage_a_u_enumeration.feasibility_set: A_xy={v in X : L_{U[x,y]} o L_v = L_x o L_y}
stage_a_u_enumeration.goal: enumerate canonical U arrays before searching V
stage_a_u_enumeration.multiset_factorization: for every u, multiset{L_x L_y : L_x(y)=u} equals multiset{L_u L_v : v in X}
stage_a_u_enumeration.next_decisive_prompt: ask whether Stage A already rules out d=5, or request a certifiable canonical enumeration scheme/count

stage_b_v_exact_cover.branching: choose a cell minimizing remaining allowed unused values in its U-fibre
stage_b_v_exact_cover.bucket_variables: V choices are bucket permutations C(u,P)->V(u,P), not arbitrary choices from A_xy
stage_b_v_exact_cover.goal: assign V after U passes Stage A
stage_b_v_exact_cover.variables: V[x,y] in bucket domain V(U[x,y], L_x L_y)
